capabilities: Counts graphemes, lines and sentences in the open note or selection
Breaks characters into hiragana, katakana, kanji, letters, digits and other kinds
Shows total and selection counts in the desktop status bar
Opens a text breakdown via command or status bar click
Counts Markdown source text as-is, including markup symbols
disambiguation: Not a proofreading or analysis tool; it shows counts only and says nothing about whether a text is good or correct.
extras: No network access, no files written, no settings or history stored; counts exist only while shown. Not tested on mobile.
problem: Obsidian's count does not separate Japanese text into hiragana, katakana, kanji and other character kinds.
summary: Japanese text counter that counts graphemes, lines and sentences in the open note or selection, split by hiragana, katakana, kanji and other kinds.
